Quest name: Creature Dwelling in SNowy Mountains
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Geography, English
Pre-Reqs: Yeti's Scalp (Giant in the High Mountain Area), Chomolungma (The Tallest Mountain in the World) and Himalayas (Hiking is Booming)

comments.body: As with other r17 quests, it requires the appropriate Boston Academy skill for it to appear. In this case, Cartographer's Growth I
